questions.title: Which European country will announce a complete drought-related shutdown of its nuclear power generation between August 1 and August 13, 2026?
questions.background: Nuclear reactors require reliable cooling-water supplies. Low river levels can force reactors to shut down, potentially disrupting national electricity supplies.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official announcements by national nuclear operators or governments, corroborated by reliable news reporting. Resolution Conditions : Identify the European country that announces, between August 1 and August 13, 2026, a shutdown covering its entire operating nuclear fleet because drought has left insufficient river water for cooling. local_articles.title: England defender Stones joins Inter Milan on two-year deal
local_articles.snippet: July 30 - England defender John Stones has joined Inter Milan on a two-year deal after leaving Manchester City at the end of last season, the Serie A champions said on Thursday. Stones, 32, spent 10 years at City where his trophy haul included six Premier League titles, three FA Cups, three League Cups, the Champions League and Club World Cup. Italian champions Inter said he had signed a contract to June 2028. No financial details were given. "After making history in Manchester, John Stones is ready for his next chapter at Inter," the club said. REUTERS
